name: Manager Review — Bulk reject items back to supervisor
description: Manager logs in with test_manager, selects TS-ITEM-002 in manager review, opens rejection modal, and rejects it back to supervisor.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page at /login
Enter test_manager into the username field and Test@123456 into the password field
Locate the item TS-ITEM-002 in the manager review list and select its checkbox
Click the reject button labelled رد موارد انتخابی به سرپرست to open the rejection modal
Enter مغایرت بحرانی در شمارش کالا، توسط سرپرست بازبینی شود into the rejection reason textarea
Click the confirm rejection button in the modal
Verify that the item TS-ITEM-002 is rejected and no longer pending in manager review
